'''Mark Zoran Revenge of the Hutt''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Mark Zoran]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14903">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14903 Revenge of the Hutt], DeckTech (Mark "Ar2Dee2" Zoran, 30 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14903/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14903/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

Strategy.
